title: solidago virgaurea subsp. stenophylla
intro: Solidago virgaurea subsp. stenophylla, commonly known as narrow-leaved goldenrod, is a subspecies of perennial plant in the family Asteraceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine and is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in wound healing and the treatment of respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Solidago virgaurea subsp. stenophylla are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which exhibit antioxidant, antihistamine, and antiseptic activities. Additionally, the plant's extracts have been shown to have immunomodulatory effects, making it a promising natural remedy for various health conditions.
